_comment: Hand-pinned corrections, applied after taxonomy.json has had its say.
Keys are owner/repo. Every field is optional:
category    replace the auto-picked category id
tags        replace the auto-picked tag list outright
add_tags    append to the auto-picked tag list
description replace the GitHub description (used for translations and
for repos whose own description says nothing useful)
Anything not listed here is left entirely to the rules.

hainguyents13/mechvibes.description: Plays mechanical keyboard and typewriter sounds as you type, with swappable sound packs.

MetaCubeX/ClashX.Meta.description: A macOS proxy client built on the Clash.Meta core, packaged as a menu bar app.

ayangweb/BongoCat.description: A cross-platform interactive desktop pet: a cat that drums along with your keystrokes and mouse.

qier222/YesPlayMusic.description: A good-looking third-party NetEase Cloud Music player for Windows, macOS and Linux.

ZToolsCenter/ZTools.description: An open-source implementation of uTools: a fast, extensible application launcher and plugin platform for macOS and Windows.

XiaoYouChR/Ghost-Downloader-3.description: A full-featured multi-threaded download manager — the only downloader you need.

guilhermeborgesbastos/live-resume.description: A fast personal web app for building a professional single-page website and resume that highlights your skills and experience.
